data.title: JPMorgan: Stock Sell-Off Nears End, Short-Term Rebound Expected; Growth Risks Could Drag Markets to New Lows in 2027
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, JPMorgan strategists said the sharp sell-off in momentum and AI-related stocks was largely over and forecast a short-term market rebound, while warning that slower economic growth could push markets to new lows in 2027.

The team, led by Karam Choudhury, described the outlook as a “three-stage bear market”: the plunge is largely over, a rebound may follow, and markets face the risk of a choppy decline in 2027.

The strategists said a European long-short momentum strategy had fallen 17.2% over 209 trading days, more than during the Russia-Ukraine conflict and close to the scale of the sell-off during the COVID-19 pandemic. Weak market sentiment, favorable seasonal factors and European quantitative macro indicators returning to a recovery range support a tactical rebound, they said. JPMorgan favors value and small-cap stocks.

data.title: EU Plans Tens of Billions of Euros in Defense Funding to Reduce Reliance on U.S. Capabilities
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, the European Union is preparing a new program of loans and grants worth tens of billions of euros to fill gaps left by U.S. cuts to operational capabilities and reduce Europe’s military dependence on Washington, people familiar with the matter said.

The proposed funding would follow the SAFE program, launched last year with €150 billion ($165 billion) to provide EU member states with low-cost financing for urgent defense needs after decades of insufficient investment. The EU is now focusing on the technology and logistics needed for large-scale conflict as the administration of U.S. President Donald Trump cuts related capabilities deployed in Europe.

The new program’s size has not been determined, and it is expected to begin in the second half of 2027. Funding would include some borrowing and money from the EU’s next seven-year budget. The discussions are at an early stage, and the sources spoke anonymously.

The plan would mark a step in the EU’s efforts to achieve military autonomy amid risks from an increasingly assertive Russia and growing doubts about Washington’s commitment to defending other NATO allies. Its final form will depend on consultations between EU member states and NATO to determine countries’ specific needs. The plan will also consider U.S. military capabilities currently deployed in Europe and those Washington has decided to withdraw.

data.title: Zambia Central Bank Holds Key Rate as Inflation Risks Rise
data.description: Zambia’s central bank kept its key interest rate unchanged as new inflation pressures emerge, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Darkfost: Bitcoin Short-Term Holder MVRV at 0.85 May Signal a Long-Term Bottom
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, crypto analyst Darkfost said Bitcoin’s short-term holder MVRV has fallen to 0.85, nearly matching the level seen at the July low. MVRV measures the unrealized profit or loss of Bitcoin holders. Above 1, holders are, on average, in profit; below 1, they are in loss.

Darkfost said the market has returned to a difficult range for short-term holders, who are carrying considerable losses. Historically, levels like these have often coincided with bottom-forming periods and may present an opportunity for long-term investors.

data.title: Nomura Forecasts 50-Basis-Point RBI Hike in December
data.description: Nomura Holdings economists now expect the Reserve Bank of India to raise interest rates by 50 basis points in December, double their previous forecast, Bloomberg reported. They cited surging food prices that threaten to keep inflation elevated for longer.

data.title: DWF Labs: Bitcoin Lagged Nasdaq by an Average 1.2% in 22 Months When Chips Outperformed After ChatGPT's Launch
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, DWF Labs said that since ChatGPT’s launch, Bitcoin underperformed the Nasdaq by an average of 1.2% during the 22 months when chip stocks outperformed the index. During the 25 months when chip stocks lagged the Nasdaq, Bitcoin outperformed it by an average of 3.6%.

Before ChatGPT’s launch, chip stocks and Bitcoin outperformed the Nasdaq by 3.3% and 3.4%, respectively.

data.title: Trader Aoying: U.S. Parties’ Internal Unity Could Spur a Second AI Rally
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, trader Aoying said a second rally in AI stocks could be near if the two U.S. parties achieve internal unity. Even if it does not develop into a major bull market, he said, a daily-chart-level rebound could occur.

Aoying also said an interest rate hike in December was certain, making subsequent dovish remarks more important; he described that debate as short-lived. He said AI technology stocks were now at more attractive prices after the Jensen Huang incident accelerated a market shakeout.

data.title: STOCKS | U.S. Stock Futures Rise Before the Open as Semiconductor Shares Rebound

data.title: Zhipu Short Liquidated as MiniMax Position Moves Within 4.75% of Liquidation
data.description:
A trader’s Zhipu short position was liquidated as the stock rose, while the trader’s MiniMax short moved closer to its liquidation price. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, Hong Kong-listed MiniMax rose 16.02% to HK$109 and Zhipu gained 14.95% to HK$336.80 after the market opened in the afternoon on November 27, according to TradingBeats monitoring.

The trader, whose Hyperliquid address is 0x334a, had the entire Zhipu short liquidated. The position was worth about $17,300, and the trader recorded a closing loss of $1,814. The address still holds a MiniMax short worth about $101,600, opened at an average price of $11.54, with an unrealized loss of about $17,300. A further 4.75% rise would reach its liquidation price of $14.57.

After Zhipu’s contract rebounded to $42.94, long positions showed mixed results. Among four tracked positions larger than $100,000, three traders had combined unrealized gains of about $43,200. The largest position, held by address 0xddb8 and opened at an average price of $105.09, remained down $1.823 million.

data.title: Solana Network's Share of Value Capture Falls to 15%
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing data from Unfolded, applications in the Solana ecosystem capture most of the revenue generated on the network, while the network itself retains a smaller share.

Network fees accounted for nearly half of combined on-chain and application revenue in early 2025. By September 2026, that share had fallen to 15%, with applications capturing about 85%.

data.title: JetBrains' 2026 Developer Ecosystem Report: 96% of Employed Developers Use AI, 55% Say Creativity Improved
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, JetBrains published its 2026 State of the Developer Ecosystem report, based on valid responses from 28,945 developers worldwide. The report found that 96% of employed developers use at least one AI tool at work. Among respondents, 55% said AI had improved their creativity, while 46% reported a reduced sense of ownership over their code.

The reported usage rates for AI tools were 39% for Anthropic Claude Code, 21% for GitHub Copilot, 17% for the ChatGPT chatbot, and 16% each for OpenAI Codex and the Anthropic Claude chatbot. Among developers who frequently use AI, 76% said it helped them code and develop faster, 74% said it sped up repetitive tasks, and 73% said it improved their overall productivity.

data.title: State Council Meeting Studies Capital Market Reform, Proposes Planning Additional Policies
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Xinhua News Agency, a State Council executive meeting discussed furthering comprehensive reforms in capital market financing and investment. The meeting said capital markets are important to overall economic development, linking corporate financing and industrial upgrading on one side with household assets and consumer confidence on the other.

The meeting called for continued improvements to mechanisms for stabilizing the market, implementation of existing policies and planning additional policies. It also called for a stronger role for state-backed institutions in stabilizing the market, further optimization of China Investment Corporation's Central Huijin's quasi-stabilization fund function, and sufficient liquidity support.

The meeting also proposed improving policies to support and guide long-term funds, including insurance funds, corporate annuities and social security funds, into the market, expanding long-term investment, and strengthening prevention and response measures for risks originating from outside the country.

data.title: SHLD.fun to Shut Down Platform After December 14
data.description: SHLD.fun, a meme token launch platform on Zcash, said it will shut down, with December 14 as its final day of operation. According to Foresight News, the platform said its V2 version had been developed and tested but would not launch because of current market conditions. The platform also said it had saved its indexer and holder data.

data.title: New York AG Wins $1.37B Judgment Against NovaTech Founders
data.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James secured a $1.367 billion court judgment against NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion over an investment scheme that defrauded hundreds of thousands of people. According to Cointelegraph, the judgment concerns the defunct crypto and forex trading company and follows a default ruling that found the Petions and NovaTech liable after they left the country and did not respond to the lawsuit. James said the judgment delivers some justice to New Yorkers targeted by the scheme in a Wednesday press release. In October, she sought an order requiring the Petions and affiliated companies to pay about $1.37 billion, comprising $1.13 billion in investor funds and $232.5 million in interest. That request followed a default judgment issued in August 2025. James sued NovaTech in June 2024, alleging it targeted immigrant communities, particularly Haitian New Yorkers, through prayer groups and social media while promising high investment returns. More than 11,000 New Yorkers lost tens of millions of dollars to NovaTech and an earlier crypto mining scheme, AWS Mining. AWS Mining collapsed in 2019, and NovaTech followed in 2023.

data.title: Binance Stock Trading to Pause During Scheduled System Upgrade
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, U.S. Stock Trading will be temporarily unavailable during a scheduled system upgrade by its partner broker. Users will not be able to place stock trading orders during the upgrade.

The upgrade is scheduled for 2026-11-28 21:50 (UTC) - 2026-11-29 00:30 (UTC), outside U.S. regular market trading hours. Downtime is expected to remain within that window but could end earlier or extend if additional work is required. Stock trading services will resume automatically once the upgrade is complete.

For more information, please refer to Binance's official announcements.

data.title: Microsoft AI Chief Mustafa Suleyman: Safety and Alignment Research Is the Only Important Task Now
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing IT Home, Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman said on November 25 that the AI industry is crossing a threshold and that safety and alignment research is currently the only important work.

Suleyman said that before achieving AI alignment, priority should be given to ensuring humans can constrain model capabilities. The discussion also covered AI performance on math problems and safety tests involving sandbox escapes, exploits, and privilege acquisition.

data.title: SEB Says U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yields May Have Reached Cycle Peak, but Sustained Decline Is Premature
data.description: SEB analysts Jussi Hiljanen and Filip Carlsson said U.S. 10-year Treasury yields may have reached the peak of the current cycle, but it is too early to expect a sustained decline. According to Odaily, they said the bond rally since mid-November was driven mainly by stock-market selloffs, concerns about the risks of excessive monetary tightening, and falling inflation expectations. If risk appetite stabilizes, Treasury yields could rise again, while persistent safe-haven sentiment would support bond prices. The strategists said they were unwilling to bet on a sustained downtrend in yields before policy rates move closer to their peak.
